_doc: What the showcase farm (every item, homes full: the heaviest farm there is) may cost, counted headless by tests/suites/world3d_test.gd test_338 as draws (each mesh or batch drawn, once per pass it is in: shown, and the sun's shadow when it casts one, on the level named) and triangles, one budget per entry. A change that pushes past a budget fails CI: make it cheaper, or raise it here on purpose with a reason in the commit. 'desktop' (mid): raised to 2.3M triangles for the animals made as files (5,000 to 10,000 each; the importer gives far ones fewer). 'phone' (low): what a low-end Android phone gets; draws and triangles are where it stands now, held so it never gets worse, and target_draws and target_triangles are where the work is heading (a low-end phone is comfortable at about 300 to 500 draws); lower the limits as it gets there, never raise them.
